name: Hoola
description: Hoola (or Hulla) is a popular Korean rummy game related to the Japanese game Seven Bridge. It is a fast-paced game of sets and runs, where the goal is to empty your hand. It features unique mechanics like 'Blasts' (winning with specific sevens) and 'Knocking' (claiming a win when your point total is low).

content.text: Hoola (or Hulla) is a popular Korean rummy game related to the Japanese game Seven Bridge. It is a fast-paced game of sets and runs, where the goal is to empty your hand. It features unique mechanics like 'Blasts' (winning with specific sevens) and 'Knocking' (claiming a win when your point total is low).
Likely developed in the late 20th century as an evolution of Western and Japanese Rummy variants (specifically Seven Bridge). It became a dominant social game in Korea.
Deal 7 cards to each player (anticlockwise). The remaining cards form the stock.

items.text: Hoola without Battles: Discard can only be taken when it is your turn; if multiple want it, the player whose turn is earlier gets it. Or play non-battle: only the player to your left's discard can be taken, on your turn.
Six or Seven Players: With 6 or 7 players, one or two drop out after the deal so exactly five play. Dealer cannot drop out; forced drop-outs may claim compensation for sevens, sets or sequences.
Hoola Multiplier: Some play that the multiplier for going out with a Perfect (all 7 cards melded at once) is only double, not quadruple.
